_comment: Protection for the three cron-driven channel branches. Deletion is blocked, non-fast-forward pushes are also blocked BUT repository administrators (RepositoryRole id 5) can bypass. This is what lets nightly-release.yml / weekly-release.yml / monthly-release.yml run their `git checkout -B nightly origin/main` + force-push integration step using RELEASE_PAT (which must belong to a repo admin). Apply with .github/workflows/apply-branch-rulesets.yml.
name: protected-cron-channels
